_comment: P13 extension (Task 07): frozen top-level package import graph for src/tensor_grep. Enforced by tests/unit/test_import_edges_baseline.py. This freezes CURRENT reality, including pre-existing layering violations (core->cli, backends->cli) that P13's still-open import-linter adoption is meant to eventually burn down -- see docs/BACKLOG.md P13. A CLI/MCP shared-service extraction (the rest of Task 07) must update this file in the same change if it legitimately adds an edge, and explain why in the commit message.
_violation_module_edges_comment: MODULE-granularity freeze of the two package-pair edges the comment above calls pre-existing layering violations (core->cli, backends->cli). The package-pair `edges` list cannot ratchet these down: once ["core","cli"] is accepted there, an unbounded number of NEW core->cli imports pass it, because that set records which KINDS of edge exist, not how many or which modules carry them. Measured 2026-09-12: 6 such imports existed and one of them (core.query_analyzer -> cli.runtime_paths, added by cbbd4a0 earlier the same day) had been introduced AFTER the freeze and passed the gate. This list may only SHRINK. Removing an entry as you burn the violation down is the intended edit; adding one requires the same scrutiny as disabling a test, and must be justified in the commit message.
_unresolved_dynamic_import_modules_comme: Modules containing a dynamic import call (import_module / __import__ / getattr indirection) whose target is NOT statically resolvable, so the walker cannot see what they import. Frozen BY NAME so a NEW opaque import call fails tests/unit/test_import_edges_baseline.py until it is resolved to a literal or consciously waived here. Reviewed 2026-10-01: backends/__init__ (16 lazy-export targets, all inside backends) and core/__init__ (9, all inside core) are __getattr__ re-export tables; cli/_main_binding imports the literal constant tensor_grep.cli.main late. None crosses a layer.
